name: Gourmet Grilled Cheese on Toasted Sourdough
whyItWorks: Golden toasted sourdough bread enclosing melted cheddar cheese is a simple, low-residue meal. Fermented sourdough is easy on the gut microbiome, making this a warm comfort food during mild remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for it lightly grilled so the bread remains soft rather than crunchy. Skip tomato slices or garlic butter spreads.
